audit.method: SHA-256 recomputed for every audited file. All statement pages of the seven audited filings are image-only (text layer holds titles only or is empty) and were rendered and read by eye; the H1 2026 review report was read from its text layer. tools/check_transcripts.py over transcripts/1303.json checks BS identity, cash-flow sum and roll (with the foreign-exchange effect), gross profit, profit before zakat less zakat to profit, cross-filing agreement of comparatives (re-presented columns carry written reasons, one 1-riyal rounding via _tol) and Q1+Q2=H1 / H1+Q3=9M rolls for revenue, cost of revenue and profit; all pass. The group has no non-controlling interest, so profit equals profit attributable to shareholders.

value_correctness.summary: Headline BS, income and cash-flow values (full SAR) read from pages for FY2022-FY2025, 3M 2026, 6M 2026 and 9M 2025 (plus 3M/6M 2025 and 9M 2024 and FY2021 as comparatives); identities hold with zero difference except a 1-riyal printed rounding in the FY2022 cash flow. FY2025: revenue 2,296,241,064, profit 629,929,051, total assets 2,595,425,829, equity 1,298,005,021, CFO 673,500,466, cash 350,381,125. FY2024: revenue 1,987,068,838, profit 401,730,829, CFO 688,229,937. FY2023: revenue 1,559,350,954, profit 201,033,987. FY2022: revenue 1,066,088,833, profit 94,170,010; FY2021 revenue 770,687,910, profit 48,845,470. 6M 2026: revenue 1,370,004,882, profit 402,302,932 (Q1 190,770,347 + Q2 211,532,585 rolls exactly; Q1+Q2 revenue and cost roll exactly); 9M 2025: revenue 1,598,066,902, profit 421,215,163 (6M 260,148,012 + Q3 161,067,151). Dividends paid 417,187,500 in H1 2026 (140,625,000 in Q1). Declared differences, never substituted: (1) FY2023 cash flow in the FY2023 filing CFO 107,136,111 / CFI -29,689,779 vs 107,137,204 / -29,690,872 in the FY2024 filing (dividend income 1,093 moved). (2) FY2022 cash flow in the FY2022 filing CFO -87,649,795 / CFI -10,430,908 vs -87,650,807 / -10,429,895 in the FY2023 filing; FY2022 printed components sum to 56,676,582 against a printed net change of 56,676,583. (3) Balance-sheet presentation: advances from customers are shown separately from the FY2025 filing whereas the FY2024 filing includes them in accrued expenses and other current liabilities (632,827,401); totals unchanged. Interim cash flow: Q1 2026 CFO 72,627,200 vs H1 2026 195,246,399 and Q1 2025 CFO 168,994,483 vs H1 2025 242,748,098; a Q2 by subtraction from cash flow was not validated against any issued three-month cash flow. No going-concern uncertainty in note 2.3 of FY2025; the H1 2026 review conclusion is unqualified. The 2025 and 2026 filings denote currency by the new riyal glyph; unit remains riyals.
